# oriz-tts

> Free, 100% client-side text-to-speech in the browser. Paste text, pick any system voice, dial in rate/pitch/volume, and hear it read aloud with each sentence highlighting as it is spoken. No upload, no signup, no key — runs on the native Web Speech API using the voices already on your device.

Live app: https://tts.oriz.in

## Pages

- [Home / TTS studio](https://tts.oriz.in): the tool — text box, voice picker, rate/pitch/volume knobs, Speak/Pause/Resume/Stop transport, highlight-as-spoken, animated waveform, optional AI rewrite.
- [About / info](https://chirag127.github.io/oriz-tts/): what oriz-tts is, feature list, tech stack, links.
- [Source](https://github.com/chirag127/oriz-tts): MIT-licensed source on GitHub.

## Features

- [System voices](https://tts.oriz.in): every voice installed on your device — dozens of languages and accents, zero downloads.
- [Highlight as spoken](https://tts.oriz.in): each sentence lights up as it is read, for follow-along reading or proofreading by ear.
- [Rate / pitch / volume](https://tts.oriz.in): radio-console knobs, persisted to localStorage.
- [File load](https://tts.oriz.in): drag-drop or open a .txt / .md file.
- [AI rewrite (optional)](https://tts.oriz.in): reshape text for natural narration or a target reading level via @chirag127/oz-ai (g4f multi-provider, no key); degrades gracefully — core TTS always works.
- [PWA](https://tts.oriz.in): installable, works offline.

## Full text

- [llms-full.txt](https://tts.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): full site content as clean markdown for LLM ingestion.
